name: Pekah
summary: A captain who killed his king, Pekahiah, and took the throne of Israel in Samaria. In his days Assyria carried off much of Israel, and in the end Hoshea killed him and took his throne.

key_moments.title: Killing the King
key_moments.description: Pekah son of Remaliah, one of King Pekahiah's captains, plotted against him with fifty men of Gilead. He killed the king in the palace at Samaria and took his throne.

key_moments.title: Loses the North to Assyria
key_moments.description: In Pekah's days, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria captured many cities along with Gilead, Galilee and the whole land of Naphtali. He took the people captive to Assyria.

key_moments.title: Marching on Jerusalem
key_moments.description: Pekah joined Rezin king of Syria to make war on Jerusalem. They surrounded King Ahaz there but could not defeat him.
